sources.title: Llama-3.2-3B official base model card
sources.evidence: Exact base repository: text input/output, Meta attribution, September 25, 2024 release and Llama 3.2 license. Table reports 3B (3.21B), GQA, shared embeddings and 128k context; its separate quantized rows specify 8k.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 launch announcement, September 25, 2024
sources.evidence: Announces pretrained and instruction-tuned 1B/3B text checkpoints for download in BF16. Describes single-shot structured pruning from Llama 3.1 8B followed by distillation using 8B/70B teacher logits.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 base and quantized model configurations
sources.evidence: Exact llama3_2_3b base entry maps to meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B: hidden width 3072, 28 layers, 24 query heads, 8 KV heads, FFN multiplier 1.0 and scaled RoPE. Quantized entries are separately named Instruct variants.

sources.title: Model families, default precision and sequence limits
sources.evidence: Maps the exact base model to the llama3_2 family. Default checkpoint precision is BF16. That family has max_seq_length 131072 unless the checkpoint is INT4, which has 8192.

sources.title: Meta Llama Transformer reference implementation
sources.evidence: Attention uses grouped KV projections; each sequential Transformer block contains one ordinary SwiGLU feed-forward network without expert routing. Together with the exact SKU this establishes dense decoder topology. This generic implementation is not used for an exact checkpoint count.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 text prompt and function-call formats
sources.evidence: The function-calling section explicitly names Llama 3.2 1B and 3B Instruct models. It documents pythonic calls and chat roles; it supplies neither an exact-base native-tool guarantee nor a dedicated base reasoning mode.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 model documentation and quantized variant scope
sources.evidence: States the original lightweight release used BF16, later quantization covered only Instruct variants, and those quantized variants have a reduced 8k context. The prompt documentation links distinct pretrained and Instruct guidance.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: License explicitly names September 25, 2024 as the version release and grants conditional rights to use, reproduce, redistribute and modify Llama materials, including trained model weights.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint configuration access attempt
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated request returned HTTP 401. No gate was bypassed and no weights were downloaded. This failed request is not used as technical evidence.

sources.title: Combined Llama 3.2 text and quantized model card
sources.evidence: Table separately lists original 128k models and quantized 8k models, both with 3B (3.21B), GQA and shared embeddings. This updated combined card says October 24, 2024; the exact base card and September launch establish the earlier original release.

name.note: Exact official base checkpoint name; excludes Instruct and INT4 variants.

family.note: Normalized catalog family; exact release belongs to Llama 3.2.

release_date.note: Original BF16 release date. The later combined card date is not the original base release.

open_weights.note: Official downloadable checkpoints with redistribution rights, subject to the custom license and access terms.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported rounded total in billions, explicitly 3B (3.21B). Shared embeddings are reported. This is not a shape-reconciled exact count or a storage-element total; no HF aggregate is substituted.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active-parameter count is disclosed; dense architecture does not justify copying total parameters.

architecture.note: Dense autoregressive Transformer: 28 layers, width 3072, 24 query heads and 8 KV heads. Shared embeddings are explicit in the card; pruning and distillation change training/model size, not the dense inference classification.

context_window.note: Exact BF16 base sequence limit is 131072 tokens. The 8192-token INT4 limit belongs to separately released quantized Instruct variants.

modalities.note: Text-only base model; generated code is text. Vision siblings are separate checkpoints.

reasoning.note: No dedicated reasoning mode is disclosed for this base checkpoint. General reasoning benchmarks or prompted chain-of-thought do not establish such a mode.

tool_call.note: Native structured function calling is documented for Instruct. No affirmative or negative exact-base capability statement supports a boolean; clear the unsupported false rather than transfer Instruct behavior.

description.value: Pretrained Llama 3.2 text model with a reported 3.21B parameters, shared embeddings and a 131,072-token context.
description.note: Identifies the exact base checkpoint and its publisher-reported rounded size, shared embeddings and original context.

patch.notes: Original BF16 base checkpoint. Meta reports a rounded 3.21B total with shared embeddings, GQA and dense Transformer blocks. Developed by structured pruning of Llama 3.1 8B and distillation using 8B/70B teachers. Context is 131072; the later quantized Instruct variants use 8192. Dedicated reasoning, native base tool calling and a separately defined active count are not disclosed.
patch.description: Pretrained Llama 3.2 text model with a reported 3.21B parameters, shared embeddings and a 131,072-token context.

summary: Audited all 14 fields for the original BF16 base model. Corrects total from name-derived 3B to Meta-reported rounded 3.21B, establishes dense GQA topology and shared embeddings, and clears unsupported reasoning/tool booleans. Preserves September 25 release and 131072 context; October 24 and 8192 concern the later quantized update. Active count remains undisclosed. Gated config was inaccessible, so no exact checkpoint parameter count is claimed.
